description: What the profile routing suite must notice about the thinking effort of a task: a blank word that names a level, a setting that the pool does not hand to the runner, a follow-up or an agent started by the task, a queued task that shows or keeps none, a word that is not a level.

mutations.name: K1
mutations.what: a blank word names a level (auto) instead of naming nothing

patches.old: if (value === undefined || value === null || (typeof value === 'string' && !value.trim())) return null;
patches.new: if (value === undefined || value === null) return null;

mutations.name: K2
mutations.what: the pool does not hand the setting to the runner of a new conversation

mutations.name: K3
mutations.what: an agent a task starts does not think as the task does

mutations.name: K4
mutations.what: a queued task shows no setting

mutations.name: K5
mutations.what: a follow-up hands the runner nothing of the setting it names

patches.old: const named = effort !== null ? { reasoningEffort: effort } : {};

mutations.name: K6
mutations.what: a task record does not keep the setting

mutations.name: K7
mutations.what: a word that is not a level reaches a runner through a follow-up
